scope: Native Work Projection quick-access preference port and PostgreSQL tests. No HTTP/API cutover, frontend or browser claim.

checks.command: bun scripts/testing/test.ts --check (clean committed manifest, external untracked CRM test temporarily excluded)

behavior: Defaults are null pins with version 0.
Explicit empty pins are distinct from null.
Pins preserve saved order and allow at most six unique IDs of at most 200 UTF-16 units.
Newly added pins must be in the caller's current authorized catalogue; existing pins may remain after a grant is revoked.
Exact idempotency replay returns the committed result; a changed payload under the same key conflicts.
A stale expected version conflicts; two concurrent saves for one version have exactly one winner.
The actual TypeScript hash input and result JSON match the Rust port, including nested field order.
limits: The adapter requires the caller to own the Control transaction; no HTTP route, private-session cutover or frontend consumer is mounted by this bundle.
Catalogue availability remains caller-supplied and is not an authorization grant.
No work-card, calendar or work-item port is included.
next: Cut over the existing account quick-access request/private-session path to the native port and remove the TypeScript writer after its consumers pass.
Then port work-card preferences after Support/Workflow authority, followed by calendar and work-item projections.
